required_markers: ST.read_and_update_sig(page, page_offset, last_sig, curr_sig, delta, GHR)
normal_feedback_callback: cache_fill(evicted_addr) updates FILTER/GHR; raw evicted_addr is therefore shared external input, while private state is excluded
output_action_scope: source SPP fact only; same-page behavior is not imposed on neural inference
self_target_source_reason: multi-step lookahead can return to the trigger line and source has no pf_addr != addr guard
queue_effect_rule: CACHE::add_pq merges repeated target lines and minimum numeric fill wins, so FILL_L2=2 dominates FILL_LLC=4
student_contract: learned zero-or-unbounded-positive count, autoregressive direct signed cache-line deltas, and learned fill from chronological DEMAND(addr) and CACHE_FILL(evicted_addr); no page-offset classes, same-page rule, normal action, threshold, degree, budget, PC, or private table state enters inference
eviction_design: raw cache_fill(evicted_addr) is included because source SPP reads it; no separate eviction head is added because eviction is not an SPP output action
